login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email you signed up with.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: We'll email you a link to verify your address.
register.name: First name
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase, a lowercase and a number.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.success: Email verified. You can sign in now.
verify.updated: Email updated. You can now use the new address.
verify.invalidLink: This link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
verify.occupied: That address already belongs to another account. Request the change with a different email.
verify.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one from the sign-in screen.

forgot.title: Recover your access
forgot.subtitle: We'll email you a link to set a new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Changing it signs you out everywhere else.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Request a new one.

companies.title: Choose a company
companies.subtitle: Your account belongs to more than one.

empty.title: Your account doesn't belong to any company
empty.body: Whoever invites you has to add you from their panel. Meanwhile you can change your password and review your sessions.

companies.servicesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No services} one {# service} other {# services}}
companies.name: Name

noServices.title: This company has no services enabled
noServices.body: A platform administrator has to enable them.

service.notEnabled: This company doesn't have that service enabled.

emailChange.title: Change sign-in email
emailChange.description: Your current email is {email}. We'll keep it until you confirm the new address.
emailChange.hint: We'll send a one-time confirmation link to this address.
emailChange.sent: We sent the link to {email}. Your current email will keep working until you confirm it.
emailChange.same: That is already your current email.
emailChange.occupied: That email already belongs to another account.
emailChange.networkError: We couldn't request the change. Check your connection and try again.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Each row is a browser with an open session. Closing them all signs you out here too.

noAccess.title: You do not have access to this section
noAccess.body: Your role does not include the required permission. Whoever administers the company can grant it.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who can access {company}, and in what capacity.
members.ownerNote: An owner bypasses the permission check, not membership.
members.addBody: They need a TFV account. Inviting someone without one arrives in slice 10.
members.removeCascade: They lose access to all of the company's data.
members.ownerHint: An owner can do anything within the company. There must always be one.
members.activeHint: A deactivated membership keeps the record and loses access.

roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Each role grants a set of catalog keys. There are {total} in total.
roles.name: Role
roles.note: A role with no permissions keeps read access and loses all writes.
roles.deleteCascade: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has it assigned.} one {# person loses their role and keeps their membership.} other {# people lose their role and keep their membership.}}
roles.permissionsHint: Tick what this role grants. Anyone without a key gets a 403 when they try.
roles.peopleCount: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has it} one {# person} other {# people}}

collection.filtersHint: They apply when you press “Apply”. Unapplied changes filter nothing.
collection.noResultsBody: Try other terms, or remove a filter.
collection.errorBody: It may be a momentary outage. Try again.
collection.clearAndShowAll: Clear the filters and show everything

directory.title: Directory
directory.aliasHint: The name they appear under in your documents
directory.name: First name
directory.searchPlaceholder: Search by alias, name or email…
directory.createBody: The email is optional. If it matches a TFV account, they get linked to it.
directory.emailHint: If they have a TFV account they get linked to it. This can't be changed later.
directory.deleteCascade: Quotes and orders already issued keep their name.

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: Who {company} sells to.
clients.emptyBody: Add them by hand, or let them appear when someone buys from your store.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Who {company} buys from.
providers.emptyBody: Add them by hand, or let them appear when you buy from another TFV company.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.subtitle: Where {company} ships from and bills to.
addresses.createBody: The first one in the book becomes the primary.
addresses.deletePrimaryCascade: It's the primary one: the oldest of the rest will take over.
addresses.label: Label
addresses.labelHint: So you recognise it at a glance. Optional.
addresses.isPrimaryHint: This will unmark the current one.
addresses.makePrimaryBody: The current one will stop being primary. It's the default for shipping and billing.
addresses.searchPlaceholder: Search by label, street or city…
addresses.emptyBody: They're needed to work out shipping and to issue invoices.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.subtitle: The facilities and storage spaces {company} operates from.
warehouses.emptyBody: Each warehouse contains its physical locations and its own catalog.
warehouses.catalogSubtitle: Products, measurements and stock in this warehouse.

products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, code or description…
products.emptyBody: Root products appear here; variants and accessories live inside each product page.
products.noAccessories: This product has no associated accessories.

measurements.title: Measurements and availability
measurements.empty: This product has no measurements yet.
measurements.available: {count, plural, =0 {None available} one {# available} other {# available}}
measurements.registered: {count, plural, one {# registered unit} other {# registered units}}

storages.title: Locations
storages.subtitle: Where the equipment at {warehouse} is stored.
storages.empty: This warehouse has no locations yet.
storages.noChildren: There are no further locations inside.
storages.selectBody: Open a level to browse the facility and see which products it contains.
storages.noProductsBody: It may contain other locations even when no products are assigned directly.

quotes.title: Quotations
quotes.subtitle: The warehouse work tray, most urgent first.
quotes.searchPlaceholder: Search by folio, name or description…
quotes.emptyBody: This warehouse's quotations will appear here, ordered by what needs attention first.
quotes.noLines: This quotation has no equipment held yet.
quotes.reserved: {count, plural, one {# unit held} other {# units held}}
quotes.amountsFrozen: Frozen when the quotation closed. They do not change even if the catalogue does.
quotes.amountsLive: Computed with today's rates. They freeze when the quotation closes.
quotes.penaltyHint: Contingent amount. Not part of the total.
quotes.saveFailed: The lines could not be saved
quotes.overbooked: {count, plural, one {One line asks for more equipment than is free} other {# lines ask for more equipment than is free}}. Adjust the quantities before saving.
quotes.noLinesYet: There is no equipment on this quote yet. Search above and add it.
quotes.freeUnits: {count, plural, =0 {No free units} one {# free} other {# free}}
quotes.notEnough: {count, plural, =0 {No units are free} one {Only # unit is free} other {Only # units are free}}
quotes.allowMinting: Authorise creating the missing inventory. Created units are flagged along with the quote that prompted them.
quotes.statusHint: Only the transitions allowed from the current status are offered.
quotes.statusFailed: The status could not be changed
quotes.closedForever: This quote is closed. It does not reopen.
quotes.returnsHint: Tick what came back and in what condition. Damaged items do not return to usable stock.
quotes.registerReturn: {count, plural, =0 {Register return} one {Register # unit} other {Register # units}}
quotes.returnFailed: The return could not be registered
quotes.unpriced: Nobody set a rate for this periodicity. Type the line price.
quotes.unpricedLines: {count, plural, one {One line has no price} other {# lines have no price}}. Type it, or pick a periodicity that has a rate.
quotes.amountsUnsaved: Calculated from what you are editing. Not saved yet.
quotes.packageGoverns: The package price governs: {amount}. Line amounts stay hidden while it is set.
quotes.packagePriceHint: Replaces whatever the lines add up to. Additional concepts still add on top.
quotes.contingentHint: They stay outside the final figure.
quotes.depositHint: Charged up front and returned. Stays outside the final figure.
quotes.paymentFailed: Could not save the payment terms
quotes.discountScopeHint: Lowers each line's amount instead of the quote subtotal.
quotes.penaltyFixedHint: Empty: computed from the lines. Typing zero says there is no penalty.
quotes.additionalIncomplete: Not saved until it has a name and an amount.
quotes.spreadFeesHint: Folds them into each line's total instead of showing them apart. The quote total does not change.
quotes.spreadFeesMoot: With a package price it has no visible effect: line amounts are hidden.
quotes.advanceHint: As agreed. Reduces what is left to collect.
quotes.taxesFailed: Could not save the tax block
quotes.taxesGuide: A guide for handing over an estimate. Rates are typed by hand; it does not replace invoicing.
quotes.conceptHint: What the document reads. Without it the tax name is used.
quotes.contributionIncomplete: Not saved until it has a name and a value.
quotes.linesFrozen: This quote's equipment has left the warehouse. Lines stay locked until it comes back: register it under equipment return, below.
quotes.unpricedLine: Nobody set a price for this line. It is not free.
